thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT (sev2) — spike in 504/gateway_timeouts observed on ingress-proxy (us-west-2). 30% of requests returning 504 across app-tier. PagerDuty: ops-pagerduty triggered. Link: https://rwinf/alerts/2965432100

tanya: ack — I'm on it, switching on the incident channel. grabbing recent graphs.

sam: seeing same. nginx upstream logs show repeated "upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream" from router -> model-srv-2 pool.

michael: any recent deploys? I don't see anything in deploy-log for prod in last 20m.

tanya: no deploys. quick hypothesis: one upstream instance overloaded or network flake to provider. rolling upstream health checks show 3/8 nodes degraded.

ops-pagerduty: Paging oncall: tanya (primary) — please acknowledge.

tanya: acknowledged. first mitigation — reduce upstream concurrency and increase proxy timeout to avoid cascading 504s. applying for ingress-proxy config: ``kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/ingress-proxy PROXY_READ_TIMEOUT=60s && kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/ingress-proxy PROXY_UPSTREAM_MAX_CONN=80``

sam: running that now, applying on canary nodes first.

michael: can we failover traffic to us-east as short term? we have capacity in dedicated pools.

tanya: yes — adding routing override for router-policy: prefer-region us-east for 10m fallback. applying: ``curl -XPOST https://controlplane/route-override -d '{"prefix":"/v1/generation","prefer_region":"us-east","expires_in":"10m"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer **'``

sam: ingress env change rolled to canary, looks good. connection backlog shrunk, 504 rate dropped from 30% -> 7% in canary.

irene: creating incident note and customer impact: several customers in us-west reported elevated error rates, degraded latency, some stream disconnects. CS notified.

tanya: ok continue canary -> full rollout. doubling upstream connection pool for model-srv-2 group while we investigate root cause.

michael: I've opened a ticket with cloud provider about network flaps for the host subnet. but symptoms point to model-srv-2 being slow on long-tail LLM requests. could be KV cache pressure.

ops-pagerduty: ops-pagerduty: incident acknowledged by oncall, severity set to sev2.

sam: after full rollout and routing override, overall 504 rate stabilized <1.2%. Latency improved. reverting routing override in 20m unless provider escalates.

tanya: leaving handoff note for next shift: root cause unknown, mitigation applied (ingress timeout increased, upstream max_conn increased, routing failover to us-east). Follow-ups: (1) create alert tuning PR (reduce noisy 5xx pagering), (2) add per-upstream tail-latency dashboard, (3) run load profile against model-srv-2 to reproduce long-tail timeouts, (4) follow-up with provider ticket #CLD-8942.

irene: I'm creating the follow-up ticket in ops board and assigning to eng-ml + eng-runtime. Ticket: OPS-1278 — "Ingress 504 spike: alert tuning + upstream tail-latency dashboard".

tanya: quick note on alerting: current 5xx alert threshold is 0.1% over 5m and fires too often on minor upstream flaps. propose to change to 0.5% over 5m with a secondary 5m sustained 1% escalation to pager. also add a 504-only rule to separate gateway issues from app 5xxs.

sam: +1. I'll open a PR to ops-alerts: changes: ``- alert: High5xxRate
  expr: sum(rate(http_responses_total{code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) > 0.005
  labels:
    severity: warning
- alert: High5xxRatePager
  expr: same but > 0.01 for 5m
  labels:
    severity: page``

michael: let's also add per-upstream 95/99th latency panels to the infra dashboard and a small runbook: if 504 spike coincides with upstream 95p > 15s then fail traffic to fallback region.

irene: noted. adding dashboard task to OPS-1278 with owners: sam (dashboard + alerts), eng-ml (investigate model-srv tail latency), eng-runtime (runtime fixes).

ops-pagerduty: Closing pager: incident mitigated, monitor.

tanya: handing off to night oncall @michael — leave incident open for follow-ups, but no active paging unless 504 rate >2% over 5m. handoff note: see OPS-1278.

michael: ack — will monitor. thanks team :thumbsup:
